record.paper_title: Some Open Problems on Multiple Ergodic Averages
record.context_brief: Two-fold convergence: powers versus commuting maps
record.original_question: If an integer sequence a(n) is good for 2-convergence of powers of a single transformation, does it automatically remain good for 2-convergence of two arbitrary commuting transformations?

evidence.quote: Problem 6. If a sequence is good for 2-convergence of powers, then show that it is good for 2-convergence of commuting transformations.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(X,\mathcal{B},\mu)$ be a probability space. Call a sequence of integers $(a(n))_{n\in\mathbb{N}}$ **good for 2-convergence of powers** if for every measure-preserving transformation $T:X\to X$ on every probability space $(X,\mathcal{B},\mu)$ and for all $f_1,f_2\in L^\infty(\mu)$, the averages
$$\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=1}^N T^{a(n)}f_1\cdot T^{2a(n)}f_2$$
converge in $L^2(\mu)$ as $N\to\infty$.

Call $(a(n))_{n\in\mathbb{N}}$ **good for 2-convergence of commuting transformations** if for every probability space $(X,\mathcal{B},\mu)$, every pair of commuting measure-preserving transformations $S,T:X\to X$ (i.e. $ST=TS$), and all $f_1,f_2\in L^\infty(\mu)$, the averages
$$\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=1}^N S^{a(n)}f_1\cdot T^{a(n)}f_2$$
converge in $L^2(\mu)$ as $N\to\infty$.

Prove or disprove: every integer sequence that is good for 2-convergence of powers is also good for 2-convergence of commuting transformations.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem appears in Frantzikinakis's well-known list of open problems on multiple ergodic averages. Subsequent literature on convergence of multiple ergodic averages for commuting transformations (e.g., work by Tao, Walsh, Chu–Frantzikinakis, Frantzikinakis–Kra) treats related but distinct settings, and no source found resolves the implication "good for 2-convergence of powers implies good for 2-convergence of commuting transformations" for arbitrary sequences. The problem is generally still considered open.

status_evidence.title: Some open problems on multiple ergodic averages (Frantzikinakis)
status_evidence.snippet: A survey listing open problems on multiple recurrence and convergence including questions on sequences good for convergence of powers vs. commuting transformations.
status_evidence.claim: Problem is stated as an open problem in this survey.

status_evidence.title: Norm convergence of multiple ergodic averages for commuting transformations (Tao)
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes norm convergence for polynomial-power averages of commuting transformations, but does not address arbitrary sequences good for convergence of powers.
status_evidence.claim: Related result; does not resolve the stated implication.

status_evidence.title: Ergodic averages for commutative transformations along return times
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work on convergence of multiple ergodic averages along special sequences for commuting transformations; treats specific sequences rather than the general implication.
status_evidence.claim: Problem still appears unresolved in general.
